questions.prompt: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?

source.note: Iron oxide dust gives Mars its red colour. Check: NASA Science, 'Mars facts'.

questions.prompt: What is the chemical symbol for gold?

source.note: Au, from the Latin aurum. Ag is silver, Gd gadolinium, Pt platinum. Check: IUPAC periodic table.

questions.prompt: Which element has the atomic number 26?

source.note: Iron is 26; cobalt 27, copper 29, zinc 30. Check: IUPAC periodic table.
